narration:0:1910726001:1.text: Light bursts open followed by a succession of scenes...
narration:0:1910726001:1.male: Light bursts open followed by a succession of scenes...
narration:0:1910726001:1.female: Light bursts open followed by a succession of scenes...

say:1:1910726002:1.text: An unknown catastrophe descends. Undersea volcanoes erupt, the Deepsea becomes a hellscape, and the ocean currents are completely thrown off course.
say:1:1910726002:1.source_cn: 未知的灾难到来。海底火山喷发，深海成为炼狱，洋流也彻底...
say:1:1910726002:1.male: An unknown catastrophe descends. Undersea volcanoes erupt, the Deepsea becomes a hellscape, and the ocean currents are completely thrown off course.
say:1:1910726002:1.female: An unknown catastrophe descends. Undersea volcanoes erupt, the Deepsea becomes a hellscape, and the ocean currents are completely thrown off course.

say:2:1910726003:1.text: Schools of fish perish instantly, the coral reefs die off, and Coralia turns empty and desolate, devoid of any living soul.
say:2:1910726003:1.source_cn: 鱼群死去、珊瑚死去，塔拉萨变得灰白，空无一人。
say:2:1910726003:1.male: Schools of fish perish instantly, the coral reefs die off, and Coralia turns empty and desolate, devoid of any living soul.
say:2:1910726003:1.female: Schools of fish perish instantly, the coral reefs die off, and Coralia turns empty and desolate, devoid of any living soul.
